description: Header file for STM32F4 series FLASH RAM functions, defining external functions for flash interface control and sleep modes.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StopFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Stops the flash interface clock, runs from RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_StartFlashInterfaceClk
methods.description: Starts the flash interface clock, runs from RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_EnableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Enables flash sleep mode, runs from RAM.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_DisableFlashSleepMode
methods.description: Disables flash sleep mode, runs from RAM.
